texts.text: Below thesurface.
The useful questions are oftenone layer deeper.
Scroll to look closer
An imagined place.A real way of working.
A person behindthe systems.
I’m Victor. I’m a software developer who likes getting beneath the first description of a problem—until the moving parts start to make sense.

My experience is grounded in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and ERP work. I move between requirements, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment and support, with cross-team coordination along the way.
I’m interested in senior and technical-lead roles where that whole-picture perspective matters.
Understand deeply.Build practically.
I don’t see the first request as the whole problem. I want to understand the people, the constraints, and what needs to happen next.
Find the real question.
Work through requirements, clarify what is needed, and look for the dependencies underneath.
Make it workable.
Turn that understanding into a technical design, then implement and test the details.
Stay with the work.
Deployment is part of the process. So are support, coordination, and making the next step clearer.
Still lookinga little deeper.
Outside my day-to-day work, I keep coming back to things I can build, run, and understand for myself.
Small hardware. Big questions.
Raspberry Pi homelab and server experiments.
A different way to work.
Exploring AI-assisted work processes.
Ideas made tangible.
AI-assisted web applications.
These are interests and explorations, not client case studies.
Let’s bring itinto the light.
Have a contained problem that could use a closer look? I’m open to discussing remote, evening or asynchronous freelance work for individuals and small businesses, alongside my full-time role.
